summary:
科林研發EPS超預期近9%，記憶體設備需求復甦明確。
• EPS 1.27美元，超出預期1.17美元，驚喜幅度8.70%。
• 單季營收53.4億美元，反映設備需求穩步復甦。
• 記憶體客戶資本支出回升帶動蝕刻沉積設備訂單。
• 先進製程與封裝技術提升設備價值含量。
• 服務業務（CSBG）規模擴大，收入穩定性提升。
ai_view:
訊號正向：EPS超預期近9%，營收回溫顯示記憶體設備需求進入復甦循環。短中期股價受惠於記憶體客戶資本支出回升與AI帶動的先進製程需求。追蹤指標：記憶體與晶圓代工客戶資本支出、設備訂單與出貨、出口管制動向、服務業務成長。處於週期上行初中段為相對有利位置，但設備股波動大，須持續確認下游資本支出計畫的延續性，以支撐73倍的高本益比。

需留意：設備需求週期性強，易受半導體景氣影響。；地緣政治與出口管制限制市場拓展。；高估值對訂單能見度變化高度敏感。

summary_en:
Lam Research beats EPS by nearly 9% on a clear memory-equipment recovery.
• EPS of $1.27 beat the $1.17 estimate by 8.70%.
• Quarterly revenue of $5.34B reflects a steady equipment-demand recovery.
• Recovering memory-customer capex drives etch and deposition orders.
• Advanced-node and packaging technologies raise equipment value content.
• Growing service business (CSBG) improves revenue stability.

ai_view_en:
Signal positive: EPS beat by nearly 9% and recovering revenue show memory-equipment demand entering a recovery cycle. Near to mid-term, the stock benefits from rebounding memory-customer capex and AI-driven advanced-node demand. Track: memory and foundry customer capex, equipment orders and shipments, export-control developments, and service growth. Being in the early-to-mid upcycle is a relatively favorable position, but equipment stocks are volatile, so continued confirmation of downstream capex plans is needed to support a 73x P/E.

Watch：Equipment demand is highly cyclical, tied to the semiconductor cycle.; Geopolitics and export controls limit market expansion.; High valuation is sensitive to changes in order visibility.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS驚喜+8.70%，營收53.4億美元，記憶體與設備需求回溫。
